# Points to Splats

Turns a point cloud into coloured, round splats.

`lfs.points_to_splats` · Conversion

## How to use

Leave Radius at 0 to estimate size from nearby points.  
Set a positive radius in scene units if the automatic size leaves gaps.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry you want to edit. Connect a source; an unconnected input supplies no geometry. |
| Radius | `Radius` | lfs.float | 0 | min 0; step 0.01 | Splat radius in scene units. 0, the default, estimates half the nearby point spacing; positive values set one size. |
| Opacity | `Opacity` | lfs.float | 0.9 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01 | Splat opacity, 0–1: 0 is transparent, 1 opaque. 0.9, the default, keeps a little transparency. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Resulting geometry. Connect to another editing node or Group Output. |
